endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: None - only reads from local DB and git

findings.detail: Branch deletion uses db.WithTx2 for DB mark + git delete, but post-process notifications are fire-and-forget

non_atomic_operations: DB mark as deleted + git branch delete are in a transaction wrapper, but PushUpdate notification is async
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: If git delete fails after DB mark, branch is marked deleted but still exists in git

findings.detail: checkBranchName walks refs then push creates branch - race condition possible between check and create
findings.recommendation: Git push will fail with appropriate error if branch was created between check and push, so this is handled by git's own atomicity

non_atomic_operations: Name conflict check and branch creation are not atomic - relies on git push failure for race condition handling
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Git push failure returns appropriate conflict error

findings.detail: If a branch commit cannot be found in git (deleted between DB query and git read), it's skipped gracefully
findings.recommendation: Good pattern - already handles stale data

endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Skips branches that no longer exist in git

findings.detail: If new commit equals current commit, operation is a no-op (returns nil early)
RenameBranch uses git_model.RenameBranch with a callback that renames in git within the DB transaction
findings.recommendation: Good pattern - git rename is inside the DB transaction callback

non_atomic_operations: If default branch rename, schedule deletion and cron cancellation happen inside transaction but are logged-and-continued on error
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: If git rename succeeds but DB commit fails, branch state could be inconsistent
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Transaction rollback should handle most cases

rate_limiting.detail: No specific rate limiting on branch endpoints

dead_letter_queues.detail: Branch sync queue uses simple retry via queue framework
